scope: Independent QA of the four r001 assets only. This report is not publication approval, release decision, inventory approval, scientific reconstruction, hardware GPU certification, or parent-scene acceptance. No model, source, handoff, brief or original metadata was modified.

claims_and_limits: Sapeornis: broad wings/fan tail are consistent with consulted interpretation, but this is stylized and r001 outer tips differ visibly from concept.
Longirostravis: long slender rostrum is a supported inspiration; stylized beak and simplified teeth are not a toothless/exact-fossil claim.
Dunbaria: four main wings, small front lobes and long cerci read as intended; lobe shape and venation remain simplified.
Chimerarachne: eight walking legs, segmented abdomen and whip tail are visible; spinneret homology, eye count, sex-specific palp and phylogenetic placement are not asserted.
Counts, byte sizes and dimensions are export facts. Chimerarachne is about 7.16mm across its model bounding box; no fossil measurement claim is made.
